_doc: KGRAPH-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): "All UltraStable deployments and systems shall have a knowledge graph (graph network) to automatically build and maintain a graph of connections for all data." Every system Ultrastable runs is a row here. A system with a url builds its graph from its own data on its own clock and serves it as kg/1 (workers/core/kgraph/insight.js, vendored); a row without a url is undeclared. Read by the tick step `kgraph` (seed/worker/src/kgraph.js, through config.kgraph built in deploy/deploy-workers.mjs and seed/worker/src/handoff.js), which files KG-<id> for an undeclared, unreadable, invalid, empty or stale graph and closes it when the same reading is healthy, and by foundation/kgraph.py (--check in checks), which fails when a system in instances/ultrastable/progress.json or doctrine/tenant-repos.json has no row.
